name: Competition Preparation
tagline: Transform your dedication into stage-ready excellence.
hero_alt: Jake celebrating on stage with a competition athlete
body_alt: Team JD athletes flexing during a competition stage lineup
short_description: A full-service package to get you on stage looking your absolute best. From training and nutrition to posing and show day — every detail covered.
description: Competition preparation is more than just getting in shape — it is about achieving peak conditioning, mastering stage presence, and presenting your absolute best self when it matters most. As a Pro Physique athlete with years of competition experience, Jake understands every aspect of what it takes to succeed on stage.
expectation_title: Your target show is a direction, not a promise.
expectation_lede: Most athletes who enquire about prep need more time than they expect. Jake will assess where you are now, be direct about what is realistic, and may recommend a later season before he agrees to begin a prep.
expectations: Jake decides whether you are ready to begin competition preparation.
Your preferred season may move if more time will produce a safer, stronger result.
A consultation is a readiness assessment — it is not automatic acceptance into prep.
The right first move may be Online Coaching to build towards the stage with purpose.
who_its_for: You have at least one year of consistent training experience
You are committed to following a highly structured coaching process
You understand that competition preparation requires dedication and sacrifice
You will let readiness — not impatience — determine the timeline
You want expert guidance through every aspect of preparation

name: Online Coaching
tagline: Personalised training and nutrition guidance with real-time support. Delivered entirely online.
hero_alt: Jake reviewing a personalised online coaching plan
body_alt: Coach reviewing a client's training remotely from a phone
short_description: A tailored coaching package designed entirely around your needs and goals — delivered anywhere in the world.
description: Distance should not compromise the quality of your coaching experience. Online coaching delivers personalised attention, expert guidance, and proven structure with the flexibility to train anywhere. This is not a generic program or an automated response — it is an ongoing coaching relationship.
expectation_title: This is coaching, not a program download.
expectation_lede: Jake can only make useful decisions from useful feedback. The clients who get the most from online coaching train with intent, complete their check-ins, and communicate clearly when life or performance changes.
expectations: Record training accurately and provide the feedback Jake asks for.
Complete check-ins on time so adjustments are based on current information.
Apply feedback rather than changing the plan whenever motivation shifts.
Ask questions early instead of letting uncertainty derail the week.
who_its_for: You want professional coaching but cannot train in person with Jake
You need a flexible program that fits your lifestyle
You are looking for real accountability and live check-ins
You want individualised plans, not generic templates
You are committed to consistent progress with expert guidance

name: Personal Training
tagline: Face-to-face coaching with expert guidance to build confidence, competence, and results.
hero_alt: Jake coaching a client through an in-person gym session
body_alt: Coach guiding a battle-rope session on the gym floor
short_description: One-on-one coaching focused on proper form, progressive programming, and achieving your individual fitness goals.
description: Nothing replaces face-to-face coaching in a professional gym environment. Personal training delivers focused attention, expert guidance, and immediate feedback through dedicated one-on-one sessions. It is a practical route to better technique, real competence, and confidence under load.
expectation_title: Turn up ready to learn, not just to sweat.
expectation_lede: The value of personal training comes from applying feedback, repeating good movement, and building skill over time. Sessions are focused and progressive — not random workouts chosen for entertainment.
expectations: Attend sessions in Melbourne reliably and arrive ready to train.
Use immediate technique feedback instead of chasing load at any cost.
Practise the standards established in sessions when training independently.
Treat progress as a skill-building process, not a single hard workout.
who_its_for: You want hands-on coaching and immediate form correction
You are new to training and want to build a strong foundation
You have hit a plateau and need expert programming to break through
You want structured, progressive sessions with full accountability
You are in or near Melbourne and can train in person

name: Posing
tagline: Master the art of presentation and maximise your competitive edge on stage.
hero_alt: Jake demonstrating a competition pose during a coaching session
body_alt: Athlete holding a sculpted pose under stage lights
short_description: Expert posing instruction that showcases your physique's strengths and maximises your competitive edge — for all federations.
description: Your physique tells a story, but your posing brings it to life. The way you present on stage can be the difference between being overlooked and commanding attention. Jake provides specialised coaching to help competitors showcase their strengths and present with control and confidence.
expectation_title: The session teaches it. Practice makes it yours.
expectation_lede: Posing improves through repetition. Jake can refine positions, transitions, and presentation, but you need to practise between sessions until the details feel deliberate under pressure.
expectations: Practise the positions and transitions Jake gives you between sessions.
Be open to direct feedback on how your physique presents from every angle.
Learn the requirements of your division rather than copying another athlete.
Build a presentation you can repeat with confidence under stage conditions.
who_its_for: You are preparing for a competition and need posing guidance
You have your physique dialled in but want to present it better
You are competing in any federation or division
You are a first-timer who wants to walk on stage with confidence
You are an experienced competitor refining your presentation

includes.title: Mandatory Pose Mastery
includes.description: Division-specific instruction, proper form, angles, and technique refinement, with individual adjustments for your physique.

includes.title: Individual Posing Routine
includes.description: Custom choreography tailored to your strengths, music guidance, seamless transitions, and personality integration.

includes.title: Physique Presentation Strategy
includes.description: Highlighting your best features, improving positioning, and aligning presentation with division expectations.

includes.title: Stage Presence Training
includes.description: Confidence, performance psychology, stage walking, audience engagement, judge connection, and competition-day mindset.

qualification.title: Are you looking for posing-specific coaching?
qualification.intro: Posing is a focused service. If you need complete contest or physique coaching, another Team JD path will cover the work you are actually asking for.
qualification.pass_copy: You are looking for focused presentation coaching and are ready to practise the detail between sessions. You can now book a posing session.
qualification.redirect_title: Your goal needs more than a posing session.
qualification.redirect_copy: Your answers point to a broader coaching service. Start there so the full scope of your goal is handled properly.
